description: Audit a described screen or flow: returns findings mapped to principles and UX smells, each with severity, remediation and business impact, plus a score, the detected interface type, strengths and the three priority fixes. Pro mode only (UXUI_API_KEY set): the audit runs on the uxuiprinciples.com API. Without a key use detect_smell then suggest_fix, which run offline.

context.description: Where the interface lives. Echoed in the result; does not change the rules.

depth.description: "quick": the top 5 findings. "full": every finding. Defaults to "full".

description.description: What the screen shows and what users do or complain about, 20 to 5000 characters. Name the components, the actions and the states you implemented (loading, empty, error, confirmation).

locale.description: Language of the findings: "en" or "es". Defaults to "en".

name: audit_interface
title: Audit an interface
